Aan. Meet- en marketingscripts wachten o: On. Analytics and marketing scripts wait for consent.
Automatisch: cookies van de website zelf: Automatic: cookies of the website itself and of services you set up, such as Google Analytics or the Meta pixel. Found by scan: the scan fetches a number of pages and recognises known scripts such as Hotjar, TikTok and LinkedIn. Manual: what you add yourself.
Basis is de veilige keuze. Bij geavancee: Basic is the safe choice. In advanced mode Google sends cookieless measurements without consent, so Google Ads and GA4 can estimate the missing conversions. Discuss this with the client: the Dutch Data Protection Authority is stricter about this than Google.
Basis: Google laadt pas na toestemming: Basic: Google loads only after consent
Bepaalt onder welke kop de cookie op de: Determines under which heading the cookie appears on the cookie page, and for which consent the cookie is removed when consent is withdrawn.
Bezoekers krijgen de banner opnieuw te z: Visitors will see the banner again
Bijvoorbeeld: 1 jaar, 30 dagen of Sessie: For example: 1 year, 30 days or Session.
Cookiebanner, Google Consent Mode, de co: Cookie banner, Google Consent Mode, the cookie page and the texts per language.
Cookies die JavaScript zet zonder dat he: The scan does not see cookies that JavaScript sets unless the script belongs to a known service. If you added a script yourself in the extra scripts, add its cookies manually.
Daarna vraagt de banner het opnieuw. De: After that the banner asks again. The Dutch Data Protection Authority advises 12 months at most.
De AI deelt de geselecteerde cookies zon: The AI classifies the selected cookies without a category or description and writes a description. That appears on the cookie page right away; review it afterwards.
De AI gaf geen bruikbaar voorstel: The AI gave no usable suggestion
De cookie-instellingen zijn opgeslagen: The cookie settings have been saved
De cookiebanner staat aan, maar het over: The cookie banner is on, but the overview or the settings are not complete.
De laatste scan is van :date. Draait de: The last scan is from :date. Is the scheduler running on the server?
De naam van de cookie. Gebruik * voor ee: The name of the cookie. Use * for a range, for example _ga_*.
De nieuwe cookiebanner staat aan: haal b: The new cookie banner is on: remove the above, otherwise visitors see two banners.
De pagina waar het blok Cookieoverzicht: The page with the Cookie overview block. The banner links to it.
De scan haalt de homepage en tot tien pa: The scan fetches the homepage and up to ten pages from there, reads which cookies the server sets and recognises known scripts such as Google Analytics, Meta, Hotjar and TikTok. It runs in the background; refresh this list in a minute.
The scan found 1 cookie without a category. It is not on the cookie page and is not blocked.
De scan vond :count cookies zonder categ: The scan found :count cookies without a category. They are not on the cookie page and are not blocked.
De scan vond ook :banner op de site. Bez: The scan also found :banner on the site. Visitors then get two banners; remove the old one (php artisan dashed:cookies:migrate-banner shows where).
De site gebruikt meet- of marketingdiens: The site uses analytics or marketing services but does not ask for consent. That is not allowed under the GDPR and the Dutch Telecommunications Act.
Dit is een voorstel van de AI. Controlee: This is a suggestion from the AI. Check it before saving: it will then appear on the cookie page.
Een automatische cookie aanpassen kan; h: You can edit an automatic cookie; it will no longer be overwritten afterwards.
Een kleine knop in de hoek waarmee een b: A small button in the corner that lets a visitor change their choice at any time. If you turn it off, put a link in the footer with data-cookie-settings or <x-dashed-cookies::settings-link/>.
Elke bezoeker krijgt de banner opnieuw t: Every visitor sees the banner again and has to choose again. Do this when you add a new service that sets cookies, or when the purpose of existing cookies changes. Consent given earlier no longer applies.
Geavanceerd: Google laadt altijd, zonder: Advanced: Google always loads, without cookies until consent
Geen cookiepagina gekozen. Zet het blok: No cookie page selected. Put the Cookie overview block on a page and select it under Settings, Cookies.
Geldt voor de extra scripts bij Instelli: Applies to the extra scripts under Settings, General and to scripts per page. You can override it per script with data-cookie-category="analytics" in the script tag.
Gevonden cookies die nog ingedeeld moete: Found cookies that still need to be classified
Het bewijs dat een bezoeker toestemming: Proof that a visitor gave consent. Keep it at least as long as the consent applies, plus the time in which someone can ask about it. Default: 1095 days (3 years).
Het cookieoverzicht is bijgewerkt: The cookie overview has been updated
Het overzicht van alle cookies die de we: The overview of all cookies the website sets. It appears on the cookie page (the Cookie overview block) and determines which cookies are removed when a visitor withdraws consent.
In gewone taal: waarvoor wordt deze cook: In plain language: what is this cookie used for?
Empty uses the main colour of the emails.
Leeg laten gebruikt de standaardtekst, d: Leaving it empty uses the default text, shown as an example in each field.
Let op de leesbaarheid van de banner: Mind the readability of the banner
Linktekst naar de cookiepagina: Link text to the cookie page
Met de banner aan laden Google Analytics: With the banner on, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, the Meta pixel and the extra scripts only load once the visitor consents. Every choice is recorded as proof.
Na het toevoegen van een nieuwe dienst:: After adding a new service: ask for consent again in the cookie settings.
Nieuwe cookies verschijnen hier zodra hi: New cookies appear here once it is done. You have to classify cookies without a category yourself.
Nog nooit gescand. Start een scan bij Co: Never scanned. Start a scan under Cookies.
Necessary cookies are always on. Only ask for categories the site actually uses.
Of een eigen URL voor de cookiepagina: Or a custom URL for the cookie page
Onbekende cookies: :cookies. Deel ze in: Unknown cookies: :cookies. Classify them under Cookies.
Opent de cookie-instellingen, zodat een: Opens the cookie settings so a visitor can change their choice.
Plaatst een nieuwe dienst cookies, vraag: If a new service sets cookies, ask for consent again under Settings, Cookies.
Rechtstreeks vereist; kan weg als de ban: Required directly; can be removed once the banner is no longer used.
Tekst bij een tegengehouden video of kaa: Text for a blocked video or map (:provider: becomes the service)
Uit, maar de site gebruikt al :banner. O: Off, but the site already uses :banner. You can switch over under Settings, Cookies.
Uit, terwijl :services zonder toestemmin: Off, while :services measure without consent. Turn on the cookie banner under Settings, Cookies.
Uit. De site gebruikt geen bekende meet-: Off. The site uses no known analytics or marketing services.
Vindt de scan een cookie die hij niet ke: If the scan finds a cookie it does not know, it is listed as "Not classified" and not yet shown on the cookie page. Give it a category and a description, or hide it if it is not from your site.
For the box and the floating button.
Voorstel voor :name: Suggestion for :name
Vraagt de browser om niet gevolgd te wor: If the browser asks not to be tracked (GPC), "Accept all" does not turn on marketing and the banner shows a short notice. The visitor can still turn marketing on in the settings.
Waar komen de cookies vandaan?: Where do the cookies come from?
Wat de scan niet ziet: What the scan does not see
Wie de cookie plaatst, bijvoorbeeld Goog: Who sets the cookie, for example Google Analytics or the name of the website.
YouTube, Vimeo, Google Maps en andere in: YouTube, Vimeo, Google Maps and other embedded content only load after consent. The visitor sees a placeholder with a button to load a single embed anyway. YouTube always loads via youtube-nocookie.com.
Zet de cookiebanner aan bij Instellingen: Turn on the cookie banner under Settings, Cookies, and check the cookie overview.
Zet de cookies van de diensten die nu aa: Adds the cookies of the services that are currently on (such as a filled-in Google Analytics ID) to the list.
Zet eerst de nieuwe cookiebanner aan bij: First turn on the new cookie banner under Settings, Cookies, then remove the above. data-cookieconsent attributes are harmless but redundant.
Zet je dit aan, controleer dan eerst het: If you turn this on, first check the cookie overview and the texts below.
Zie de details van de bevinding; alles i: See the details of the finding; everything can be fixed under Cookies and Settings, Cookies.
Zoveel bezoekers telt Google Analytics n: This share of visitors is still fully counted by Google Analytics
Zoveel bezoekers zijn nog te volgen voor: This share of visitors can still be tracked for ads
Gepseudonimiseerd: alleen een toestemmin: Pseudonymised: only a consent ID, no email address. Cannot be linked to this person; the entries expire with the retention period.
